listedCourseDetails: Luxury Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Enjoy Six Types of Sushi, Tempura, and Wagyu Caviar Hand Rolls! — JPY 5,500 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 40. Experience the full charm of Sushi Planet with this satisfying course! Start with a selection of six unique appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, and grilled oysters in oil. As you progress, enjoy new flavors with chawanmushi made with aosa seaweed, perfectly grilled salmon belly, and three types of freshly fried tempura. Indulge in six varieties of nigiri sushi featuring tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream, and finish off with a luxurious hand roll of Wagyu beef and caviar! This course is perfect for those who want to fully enjoy both sushi and a la carte dishes, making it ideal for meals and banquets.

Casual Enjoyment Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Five Types of Freshly Fried Tempura and Six Types of Sushi! Sushi Planet Party Course — JPY 4,500 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 40. Enjoy a classic course at Sushi Planet that lets you savor everything from appetizers to tempura and sushi! Start with six types of appetizers, including oil-marinated oysters, duck loin, and tamagoyaki, followed by five varieties of freshly fried tempura. We also offer a diverse selection of six types of nigiri sushi, featuring tuna, horse mackerel, sea bream, boiled shrimp, toro-taku, and amberjack. This course is perfect for days when you want to enjoy a variety of snacks with a drink in hand or when you want to indulge in a full meal. Ideal for dining with friends or after-work gatherings!

Ultimate Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Featuring Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, Six Types of Sushi, and Freshly Fried Tempura! Sushi Planet Premium Course — JPY 6,500 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 40. Indulge in the premium course at Sushi Planet, featuring luxurious Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu and sushi! Start with a vibrant selection of six appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, Ume Suisho, and oil-marinated oysters, followed by a delicate chawanmushi made with Aosa seaweed. The main course showcases tender Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, accompanied by three types of tempura and six varieties of nigiri sushi, including tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream. To conclude, enjoy a playful Unatama Dog and Aosa miso soup. This course is perfect for special occasions when you want to savor both Wagyu and sushi!

capabilities.name: ASK_USER
capabilities.purpose: Request a user clarification that is necessary or useful to proceed safely.
capabilities.inputSchema: question, optional relatedFields
capabilities.resultMeaning: The task waits for a new user message; no state constraint is changed.
importantConstraints: Do not claim a booking or availability result.

capabilities.name: SEARCH_RESTAURANTS
capabilities.purpose: Discover matching restaurant outlets.
capabilities.inputSchema: optional retrievalHint; the router binds authoritative intent
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns RestaurantCandidate records only, without availability claims.
importantConstraints: Cannot modify, repeat, or loosen authoritative user constraints.

capabilities.name: INVESTIGATE_CANDIDATE_FACTS
capabilities.purpose: Read source-supported restaurant facts needed by the current request for known candidates.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds candidates and authoritative request conditions
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns candidate-associated source facts or an explicit unknown result; it never asserts availability.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; at most three candidates per bounded read; it does not itself claim a slot.

capabilities.name: CHECK_AVAILABILITY
capabilities.purpose: Read request-bound availability and any source-supported restaurant facts returned with it.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds authoritative date, time window, and party size
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns fresh AvailabilityOffer records associated with candidate IDs.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; schedule values are never Agent-supplied; at most three unchecked candidates per read batch.

capabilities.name: END_READ
capabilities.purpose: End a bounded read-only investigation when its recorded scope has no grounded result to present.
capabilities.inputSchema: no business fields; optional short decision summary is trajectory-only
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes a scoped NO_VERIFIED_RESULT outcome from authoritative investigation records, never a global negative claim.
importantConstraints: Only code may allow this after actual investigation; it cannot hide an internal failure, pending refresh, or grounded candidate.

capabilities.name: PRESENT_RESULTS
capabilities.purpose: Pause a read-only selection session with candidates whose required facts and availability are grounded.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; validator derives the required evidence from authoritative State
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes an evidence-grounded result batch and waits for explicit user continuation; it does not select, authorize, or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: Every task-critical fact, including each HARD criterion and availability, must have current trusted evidence.

capabilities.name: SELECT_CANDIDATE
capabilities.purpose: Choose a discovered candidate and optionally its known offer for a possible booking proposal.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, optional offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Records the selection; it does not authorize or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: A selected offer must belong to the selected candidate.

capabilities.name: BOOK_RESERVATION
capabilities.purpose: Request a booking proposal for one selected fresh offer.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Creates a deterministic ActionProposal and waits for valid user authorization.
importantConstraints: Cannot authorize, commit, or claim success.

capabilities.name: ASK_USER
capabilities.purpose: Request a user clarification that is necessary or useful to proceed safely.
capabilities.inputSchema: question, optional relatedFields
capabilities.resultMeaning: The task waits for a new user message; no state constraint is changed.
importantConstraints: Do not claim a booking or availability result.

capabilities.name: SEARCH_RESTAURANTS
capabilities.purpose: Discover matching restaurant outlets.
capabilities.inputSchema: optional retrievalHint; the router binds authoritative intent
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns RestaurantCandidate records only, without availability claims.
importantConstraints: Cannot modify, repeat, or loosen authoritative user constraints.

capabilities.name: INVESTIGATE_CANDIDATE_FACTS
capabilities.purpose: Read source-supported restaurant facts needed by the current request for known candidates.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds candidates and authoritative request conditions
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns candidate-associated source facts or an explicit unknown result; it never asserts availability.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; at most three candidates per bounded read; it does not itself claim a slot.

capabilities.name: CHECK_AVAILABILITY
capabilities.purpose: Read request-bound availability and any source-supported restaurant facts returned with it.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds authoritative date, time window, and party size
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns fresh AvailabilityOffer records associated with candidate IDs.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; schedule values are never Agent-supplied; at most three unchecked candidates per read batch.

capabilities.name: END_READ
capabilities.purpose: End a bounded read-only investigation when its recorded scope has no grounded result to present.
capabilities.inputSchema: no business fields; optional short decision summary is trajectory-only
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes a scoped NO_VERIFIED_RESULT outcome from authoritative investigation records, never a global negative claim.
importantConstraints: Only code may allow this after actual investigation; it cannot hide an internal failure, pending refresh, or grounded candidate.

capabilities.name: PRESENT_RESULTS
capabilities.purpose: Pause a read-only selection session with candidates whose required facts and availability are grounded.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; validator derives the required evidence from authoritative State
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes an evidence-grounded result batch and waits for explicit user continuation; it does not select, authorize, or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: Every task-critical fact, including each HARD criterion and availability, must have current trusted evidence.

capabilities.name: SELECT_CANDIDATE
capabilities.purpose: Choose a discovered candidate and optionally its known offer for a possible booking proposal.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, optional offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Records the selection; it does not authorize or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: A selected offer must belong to the selected candidate.

capabilities.name: BOOK_RESERVATION
capabilities.purpose: Request a booking proposal for one selected fresh offer.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Creates a deterministic ActionProposal and waits for valid user authorization.
importantConstraints: Cannot authorize, commit, or claim success.

Experience the full charm of Sushi Planet with this satisfying course! Start with a selection of six unique appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, and grilled oysters in oil. As you progress, enjoy new flavors with chawanmushi made with aosa seaweed, perfectly grilled salmon belly, and three types of freshly fried tempura. Indulge in six varieties of nigiri sushi featuring tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream, and finish off with a luxurious hand roll of Wagyu beef and caviar! This course is perfect for those who want to fully enjoy both sushi and a la carte dishes, making it ideal for meals and banquets.

Enjoy a classic course at Sushi Planet that lets you savor everything from appetizers to tempura and sushi! Start with six types of appetizers, including oil-marinated oysters, duck loin, and tamagoyaki, followed by five varieties of freshly fried tempura. We also offer a diverse selection of six types of nigiri sushi, featuring tuna, horse mackerel, sea bream, boiled shrimp, toro-taku, and amberjack. Indulge in the premium course at Sushi Planet, featuring luxurious Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu and sushi! Start with a vibrant selection of six appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, Ume Suisho, and oil-marinated oysters, followed by a delicate chawanmushi made with Aosa seaweed. The main course showcases tender Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, accompanied by three types of tempura and six varieties of nigiri sushi, including tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream. To conclude, enjoy a playful Unatama Dog and Aosa miso soup. This course is perfect for special occasions when you want to savor both Wagyu and sushi!

Luxury Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Enjoy Six Types of Sushi, Tempura, and Wagyu Caviar Hand Rolls!

Experience the full charm of Sushi Planet with this satisfying course! Start with a selection of six unique appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, and grilled oysters in oil. As you progress, enjoy new flavors with chawanmushi made with aosa seaweed, perfectly grilled salmon belly, and three types of freshly fried tempura. Indulge in six varieties of nigiri sushi featuring tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream, and finish off with a luxurious hand roll of Wagyu beef and caviar! This course is perfect for those who want to fully enjoy both sushi and a la carte dishes, making it ideal for meals and banquets.

Enjoy a classic course at Sushi Planet that lets you savor everything from appetizers to tempura and sushi! Start with six types of appetizers, including oil-marinated oysters, duck loin, and tamagoyaki, followed by five varieties of freshly fried tempura. We also offer a diverse selection of six types of nigiri sushi, featuring tuna, horse mackerel, sea bream, boiled shrimp, toro-taku, and amberjack. This course is perfect for days when you want to enjoy a variety of snacks with a drink in hand or when you want to indulge in a full meal. Ideal for dining with friends or after-work gatherings!

Indulge in the premium course at Sushi Planet, featuring luxurious Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu and sushi! Start with a vibrant selection of six appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, Ume Suisho, and oil-marinated oysters, followed by a delicate chawanmushi made with Aosa seaweed. The main course showcases tender Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, accompanied by three types of tempura and six varieties of nigiri sushi, including tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream. To conclude, enjoy a playful Unatama Dog and Aosa miso soup. This course is perfect for special occasions when you want to savor both Wagyu and sushi!

All you can drink

[First Visit Limited, All-You-Can-Drink] Matsusaka Beef Feast Course JPY 8,500! A5 Matsusaka Beef cut by artisans, served with all-you-can-drink draft beer included!13 items

[1-minute walk from Suidobashi Station] Enjoy premium Matsusaka beef prepared in a variety of ways. Choose your preferred cuts—including rare parts you don’t usually get to try. Also enjoy popular items such as "Premium Lean Beef Yukke" (low-temperature cooked), "Seared Sushi of Matsusaka Beef Premium Loin with Caviar," and "Premium Fresh Beef Tongue." You can even savor "Premium Lean Beef Yaki-Suki" (grilled sukiyaki-style). Please enjoy a very satisfying 13-item course, generous in both portion and quality.

JPY8,500（Price including tax）per person

[Matsusaka Beef Introductory Course] JPY 5,000! A popular course to casually enjoy A5 Matsusaka Beef delivered directly from designated farms. Savor authentic Wagyu Yakiniku. *Draft Beer All-You-Can-Drink + JPY 1,50011 items

[1-minute walk from Suidobashi Station] Recommended for first-time visitors to Yakiniku Story! If you're not sure what to order, start with the Matsusaka Beef Introductory Course. We use Matsusaka beef delivered directly from a designated farm, and the course lets you casually enjoy popular dishes such as Seared Premium Matsusaka Loin Sushi and highest-grade Tongue Shabu-Shabu. A value-packed, highly satisfying course that captures the best of Yakiniku Story. Please take this opportunity to savor the exquisite flavor of Matsusaka beef.

Luxury Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Enjoy Six Types of Sushi, Tempura, and Wagyu Caviar Hand Rolls!

Experience the full charm of Sushi Planet with this satisfying course! Start with a selection of six unique appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, and grilled oysters in oil. As you progress, enjoy new flavors with chawanmushi made with aosa seaweed, perfectly grilled salmon belly, and three types of freshly fried tempura. Indulge in six varieties of nigiri sushi featuring tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream, and finish off with a luxurious hand roll of Wagyu beef and caviar! This course is perfect for those who want to fully enjoy both sushi and a la carte dishes, making it ideal for meals and banquets.

Casual Enjoyment Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Five Types of Freshly Fried Tempura and Six Types of Sushi! Sushi Planet Party Course

Enjoy a classic course at Sushi Planet that lets you savor everything from appetizers to tempura and sushi! Start with six types of appetizers, including oil-marinated oysters, duck loin, and tamagoyaki, followed by five varieties of freshly fried tempura. We also offer a diverse selection of six types of nigiri sushi, featuring tuna, horse mackerel, sea bream, boiled shrimp, toro-taku, and amberjack. This course is perfect for days when you want to enjoy a variety of snacks with a drink in hand or when you want to indulge in a full meal. Ideal for dining with friends or after-work gatherings!

JPY4,500（Price including tax）per person
Number of people
2 - 40

Ultimate Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Featuring Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, Six Types of Sushi, and Freshly Fried Tempura! Sushi Planet Premium Course

Indulge in the premium course at Sushi Planet, featuring luxurious Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu and sushi! Start with a vibrant selection of six appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, Ume Suisho, and oil-marinated oysters, followed by a delicate chawanmushi made with Aosa seaweed. The main course showcases tender Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, accompanied by three types of tempura and six varieties of nigiri sushi, including tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream. To conclude, enjoy a playful Unatama Dog and Aosa miso soup. This course is perfect for special occasions when you want to savor both Wagyu and sushi!

Luxury Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Enjoy Six Types of Sushi, Tempura, and Wagyu Caviar Hand Rolls!

Experience the full charm of Sushi Planet with this satisfying course! Start with a selection of six unique appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, and grilled oysters in oil. As you progress, enjoy new flavors with chawanmushi made with aosa seaweed, perfectly grilled salmon belly, and three types of freshly fried tempura. Indulge in six varieties of nigiri sushi featuring tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream, and finish off with a luxurious hand roll of Wagyu beef and caviar! This course is perfect for those who want to fully enjoy both sushi and a la carte dishes, making it ideal for meals and banquets.

Casual Enjoyment Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Five Types of Freshly Fried Tempura and Six Types of Sushi! Sushi Planet Party Course

Enjoy a classic course at Sushi Planet that lets you savor everything from appetizers to tempura and sushi! Start with six types of appetizers, including oil-marinated oysters, duck loin, and tamagoyaki, followed by five varieties of freshly fried tempura. We also offer a diverse selection of six types of nigiri sushi, featuring tuna, horse mackerel, sea bream, boiled shrimp, toro-taku, and amberjack. This course is perfect for days when you want to enjoy a variety of snacks with a drink in hand or when you want to indulge in a full meal. Ideal for dining with friends or after-work gatherings!

Ultimate Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Featuring Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, Six Types of Sushi, and Freshly Fried Tempura! Sushi Planet Premium Course

Indulge in the premium course at Sushi Planet, featuring luxurious Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu and sushi! Start with a vibrant selection of six appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, Ume Suisho, and oil-marinated oysters, followed by a delicate chawanmushi made with Aosa seaweed. The main course showcases tender Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, accompanied by three types of tempura and six varieties of nigiri sushi, including tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream. To conclude, enjoy a playful Unatama Dog and Aosa miso soup. This course is perfect for special occasions when you want to savor both Wagyu and sushi!

[9/19–10/31] Halloween Afternoon Tea
It’s a 2-hour café freestyle session where you can choose from 14 varieties of drinks, including teas from the brand “Mighty Leaf”. Enjoy an elegant tea time while watching the changing seasons in the rooftop garden through the windows.

---------------------------------

• The spacious interior features floor-to-ceiling glass windows offering lush greenery—a soothing setting that makes you forget you’re in the city center. Relish your afternoon tea in this cool and comfortable café.
• There are around 30 seats available. The tranquil atmosphere and attentive service ensure a truly relaxing experience.
• Each season brings a new theme, with 10 savory and sweet items made using seasonal ingredients.
• Unwind with the delightful aromas of “Mighty Leaf” teas. With the café freestyle format, help yourself to as much as you like!
---------------------------------

お飲み物はティーブランド「Mighty Leaf」の紅茶など、14種類から選べる2時間のカフェフリーに加え、乾杯ティーカクテル付きです。屋上庭園の季節の移ろいを窓越しに眺めながら、優雅なティータイムをお楽しみください。

---------------------------------
＜VMG CAFEのアフタヌーンティー＞
・一面ガラス張りで、緑豊かな景観が広がる開放的な店内。都心であることを忘れる癒しのロケーション。涼しく快適なカフェ内でアフタヌーンティーをお楽しみいただけます。
・お席は30席ほど。落ち着いた空間とサービスで、心安らぐひとときを。
・シーズンごとにテーマを変え、旬の食材を使用したセイボリー＆スイーツ10種をご用意。

listedCourseDetails: Luxury Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Enjoy Six Types of Sushi, Tempura, and Wagyu Caviar Hand Rolls! — JPY 5,500 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 40. Experience the full charm of Sushi Planet with this satisfying course! Start with a selection of six unique appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, and grilled oysters in oil. As you progress, enjoy new flavors with chawanmushi made with aosa seaweed, perfectly grilled salmon belly, and three types of freshly fried tempura. Indulge in six varieties of nigiri sushi featuring tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream, and finish off with a luxurious hand roll of Wagyu beef and caviar! This course is perfect for those who want to fully enjoy both sushi and a la carte dishes, making it ideal for meals and banquets.

Casual Enjoyment Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Five Types of Freshly Fried Tempura and Six Types of Sushi! Sushi Planet Party Course — JPY 4,500 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 40. Enjoy a classic course at Sushi Planet that lets you savor everything from appetizers to tempura and sushi! Start with six types of appetizers, including oil-marinated oysters, duck loin, and tamagoyaki, followed by five varieties of freshly fried tempura. We also offer a diverse selection of six types of nigiri sushi, featuring tuna, horse mackerel, sea bream, boiled shrimp, toro-taku, and amberjack. This course is perfect for days when you want to enjoy a variety of snacks with a drink in hand or when you want to indulge in a full meal. Ideal for dining with friends or after-work gatherings!

Ultimate Course with All-You-Can-Drink: Featuring Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, Six Types of Sushi, and Freshly Fried Tempura! Sushi Planet Premium Course — JPY 6,500 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 40. Indulge in the premium course at Sushi Planet, featuring luxurious Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu and sushi! Start with a vibrant selection of six appetizers, including corn potage, sushi-style potato salad, Ume Suisho, and oil-marinated oysters, followed by a delicate chawanmushi made with Aosa seaweed. The main course showcases tender Wagyu Tenderloin Shabu-Shabu, accompanied by three types of tempura and six varieties of nigiri sushi, including tuna, horse mackerel, and sea bream. To conclude, enjoy a playful Unatama Dog and Aosa miso soup. This course is perfect for special occasions when you want to savor both Wagyu and sushi!
